$comment: App-store manifest for the navigation applet. Documented in README.md → 'Install from the app store'. Kept generic (no navigation-specific fields outside id/port/settings) so the catalog can adopt it; src/store.js turns it into an install plan.
name: Navigation
description: Dark 3D green-vector navigation map with routing, search, traffic and trip recording. Free OpenStreetMap data, no API key needed.
notes: Navigation needs no Python venv and no model download: the generic venv and model steps of an installer are skipped.

settings.label: TomTom traffic key
settings.description: Free key for live traffic. Without it traffic is assumed from road class and time of day.
